metadata.source: User's HelloTracks account (live.hellotracks.com/zones) -- a private org tenant, not public GIS. Confirmed by the account owner: Tehsil Nishtar contains exactly these 14 UCs, no others.
metadata.method: Each UC's zone polygon was viewed individually on HelloTracks' real Mapbox/OSM basemap via screenshots the user provided. Positions here are a single representative anchor point per UC, matched against this repo's already-georeferenced mouza coordinates where a clear name match exists, refined further using landmarks shared between adjacent UCs' screenshots (e.g. 'Rajabole' appears in both UC-244 and UC-254's views). These anchors are also the generator points for the Voronoi tessellation in ucs_nishtar_tentative.geojson.
metadata.caveat: Points only, not boundaries. 'moderate' confidence = anchored to a real matched place name; 'low'/'very low' = no name match or no pixel access at all, positioned by relative adjacency only. For real UC boundary polygons, the reliable path is exporting the zones' GeoJSON from HelloTracks itself (e.g. via its Network tab) rather than screenshot tracing.
